Tributário Estratégico & Compliance Empresarial    Apoiar discussões estratégicas relacionadas a planejamento tributário corporativo;   Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas técnicas da TTMS em temas de estruturação empresarial e eficiência fiscal;   Coordenar demandas jurídicas relacionadas a riscos regulatórios e compliance.    Propriedade Intelectual & Inovação    Gerenciar temas relacionados a marcas, propriedade intelectual, softwares, licenciamento e proteção de ativos;   Apoiar registros de marcas e proteção estratégica da expansão da TTMS;   Atuar em contratos relacionados a tecnologia, IA, dados e plataformas digitais.    Gestão & Crescimento da Área Jurídica    Apoiar a construção da área jurídica interna da TTMS;   Participar da definição de fluxos, políticas e estrutura jurídica corporativa;   Interagir diretamente com sócios e lideranças executivas;   Desenvolver visão de liderança para futura posição de Gerência Jurídica.    Requisitos    Formação em Direito com OAB ativa;   Sólida experiência em jurídico corporativo empresarial;   Experiência relevante em contratos empresariais e societário;   Vivência com demandas trabalhistas corporativas;   Boa capacidade de redação jurídica e negociação;   Inglês profissional (intermediário/avançado) para leitura, contratos e reuniões;    Diferenciais    Experiência em empresas de tecnologia, consultoria ou multinacionais   Vivência com expansão internacional;   Conhecimento em propriedade intelectual e contratos de tecnologia;   Experiência com estruturação societária e investimentos;   Pós-graduação em Direito Empresarial, Societário, Tributário ou áreas correlatas.    Valorizamos profissionais com:    Autonomia e senso de dono;   Pragmatismo e organização;   Facilidade para negociar e se comunicar;   Interesse real por tecnologia, inovação e expansão internacional;   Energia para atuar em um ambiente de crescimento acelerado.   Buscamos alguém que tenha conforto em atuar próximo da liderança da empresa, participar de discussões estratégicas e ajudar a estruturar uma companhia em crescimento.   Oportunidade de Crescimento    Esta posição possui perspectiva concreta de evolução para:   Gerência Jurídica;   Participação estratégica em expansão internacional;   Desenvolvimento de estruturas societárias e novos negócios da companhia.    A TTMS valoriza profissionais com mentalidade empreendedora, autonomia e vontade real de construir algo relevante no mercado.   A TTMS atua integrando:   Inteligência operacional.   Estamos construindo uma empresa com atuação internacional e forte presença nos setores industrial e automotivo, conectando estratégia, operações e tecnologia de forma integrada.   Buscamos alguém que queira ir além da rotina jurídica tradicional e participar ativamente da construção de uma empresa em rápida expansão. Aqui, há espaço real para crescimento, liderança e protagonismo.   Clique em ‘Candidatar-se à vaga’ para se inscrever e enviar seu currículo. Estamos animados para conhecer você! #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Supervisor Comercial - Vendas Varejo / Bens de Consumo
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Supervisor Comercial - Vendas Varejo / Bens de Consumo em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Região de Engenheiro Coelho / Campinas, SP (com disponibilidade para viagens)  Contratante: indústria brasileira em plena expansão, dedicada a fabricar e distribuir produtos de higiene e limpeza, com forte compromisso com a qualidade e o meio ambiente.   Atendimento exclusivo B2B, focado na personalização e na melhor relação custo-benefício. Estamos em um momento decisivo de crescimento, profissionalizando nossa gestão, expandindo nossa rede de distribuidores para todo o Brasil e com a visão clara de nos tornarmos um dos três maiores players do setor.   O Supervisor Comercial será uma peça-chave na transformação e estruturação da nossa área de vendas. Buscamos um profissional com perfil "mão na massa", que não apenas gerencie, mas também construa processos, desenvolva a equipe e execute a estratégia comercial em campo. Este líder colaborará diretamente com a Diretoria Comercial para refinar e implementar o planejamento estratégico, sendo o elo fundamental entre a gestão e a força de vendas. O candidato ideal é um construtor, motivado pelo desafio de criar uma máquina de vendas robusta em um ambiente familiar, ágil e com grande potencial de crescimento.   Principais Responsabilidades:    Gestão e Desenvolvimento da Equipe de Vendas:   Liderar, treinar e motivar a equipe de representantes comerciais, incluindo profissionais experientes, estabelecendo uma cultura de alta performance, disciplina e foco em resultados. Recrutar, contratar e treinar novos representantes para expansão de territórios. Implementar e garantir a execução de rotinas de vendas diárias e semanais (planejamento de rotas, prospecção, positivação, follow-up). Realizar rotas em campo com a equipe para suporte, treinamento, avaliação da execução no ponto de venda e atendimento a clientes estratégicos.   Estratégia e Planejamento Comercial:   Colaborar com a Diretoria na definição de metas de faturamento, volume, positivação e mix de produtos. Analisar dados de vendas para identificar oportunidades de crescimento, rentabilização e otimização de esforços. Desenvolver e implementar políticas comerciais, incluindo estratégias de precificação, descontos e comissionamento, com base em pesquisas de mercado e análise de concorrência. Planejar a expansão para novos mercados e canais de venda.   Execução e Trade Marketing:   Garantir excelência na execução no ponto de venda. Desenvolver ações de trade marketing para aumentar a visibilidade, o giro dos produtos e fortalecer a marca nos canais de venda. Gerenciar o relacionamento com distribuidores, garantindo alinhamento estratégico e desempenho.   Processos e Análise de Dados:   Ser o guardião dos KPIs, analisando resultados e reportando à diretoria para tomadas de decisão rápidas e precisas. Participar da transição de gestão manual de pedidos para um sistema automatizado e integrado, colaborando com a equipe interna. Fornecer insights do campo e da equipe de vendas para o planejamento de S&OP, conectando demandas comerciais à capacidade produtiva e logística.    Qualificações e Perfil do Candidato:    Experiência Essencial:   Sólida experiência em gestão de equipes de vendas externas (representantes comerciais, vendedores), preferencialmente no setor de bens de consumo, higiene e limpeza, ou em distribuidores. Vivência prática em campo, realizando rotas e negociações B2B. Habilidade com dados e indicadores (KPIs). Experiência na definição e implementação de políticas comerciais e ações de trade marketing. Histórico de sucesso em expansão de mercado e contratação de representantes. Conhecimento do mercado de limpeza será um diferencial.   Habilidades Comportamentais:   Liderança resiliente e inspiradora, capaz de gerenciar perfis diversos pelo exemplo, respeito e foco em objetivos comuns. title: [Ambev Global Tech] SAP Basis Consultant
description:

Essa iniciativa global envolve a migração para o  SAP S/4HANA   , modernizando processos e sistemas em escala inédita, conectando times de diferentes países e impactando diretamente a forma como operamos e inovamos.   Se você quer fazer parte dessa jornada e atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, global e desafiador, essa vaga é para você.   Estamos à procura de um Consultor SAP BASIS, que será responsável por conduzir a implementação técnica de projetos SAP RISE, administração de sistemas, suporte de ambientes SAP hospedados em RISE, infraestruturas.   Como especialista técnico importante, o consultor lidará com as atividades de administração do sistema de ponta a ponta, incluindo implementações do RISE with SAP, cópias do sistema, upgrades e atualizações, automação pós-cópia e configurações de integração. A função requer foco na configuração do sistema gerenciado, configuração de transportes CTS+, configurações do conector de nuvem, Web Dispatcher, SSO do aplicativo e do HANA e tratamento de certificados. O candidato trabalhará em estreita colaboração com as equipes técnicas / funcionais, a equipe Sap RISE -ECS e os clientes para garantir a implementação e as operações do sistema SAP suaves, seguras e otimizadas.   Planejar e executar implementações do sistema SAP RISE, incluindo atividades pós-HSC (cópia do sistema Hana), atividades de integração ao cenário assim que o RISE entregar o sistema ao cliente;   Executar cópias e atualizações do sistema em paisagens (S/4 HANA, Gerenciamento de Transporte, PO, SLT), incluindo atividades de pós-cópia e validação;   Configurar e solucionar problemas do SAP Cloud Connector para integração segura da nuvem com o local;   Configurar e manter os sistemas no SLD, concluir a Configuração do Sistema Gerenciado no Solution Manager;   Executar atividades de pós-atualização do SAP PO, incluindo a execução do assistente de configuração, SAP PI/PO, AEX SLD Self registration, reconstruções de cache, certificados e validações de adaptador;   Configurar e gerencie o CTS+ para gerenciamento de transporte em ambientes SAP complexos;   Lidar com configurações e manutenção do Web Dispatcher para balanceamento de carga e segurança;   Configurar o Single Sign-On (SSO)/SAML/OAuth e gerencie certificados digitais;   Experiência em administração SAP BASIS e HANA com envolvimento em projetos SAP RISE;   Experiência prática com atividades de cópia e atualização do sistema, incluindo automação pós-cópia;   Proficiência na configuração do SAP Cloud Connector, Web Dispatcher, SSO e manipulação de certificados digitais;   Forte conhecimento dos requisitos e administração pós-atualização do SAP PO (Process Orchestration);   Experiência com configuração CTS+ e configurações de caminho de transporte em cenários multissistemas;   Familiaridade com o SAP Solution Manager, especialmente para configurações e monitoramento de sistemas gerenciados;   Conhecimento da arquitetura do cenário de sistemas SAP, alta disponibilidade e estratégias de recuperação de desastres;   Inglês avançado/fluente;   Formação superior completa;   Habilidades necessárias: SAP BASIS, HANA Administration, SAP RISE Implementations, System Copy/Refresh- ABAP e JAVA Stack, SAP Cloud Connector, Configuração do Sistema Gerenciado, Atividades de Pós-Atualização do SAP PO, Configuração CTS+, Configurações do Web Dispatcher, SSO, Tratamento de Certificados, S4 Upgrade.   Vale refeição ou alimentação ifood;   Plano de saúde e Telemedicina;   Convênio odontológico;   Convênio Farmácia;   Seguro de vida;   Instituto Ambev de Previdência Privada;   Auxílio Material Escolar;   Cesta de Natal e Kit Congelado;   Empresa cidadã (licença maternidade e paternidade) e presente do bebê;   Desconto mensal em produtos AMBEV;   Abono anual referente a um salário.   Step 2: Validação de Perfil 2 Validação de Perfil   Step 3: Entrevista com a Gestão 3 Entrevista com a Gestão    Isso mesmo, o Hub de Tecnologia da Ambev!   Somos responsáveis por impulsionar a transformação digital da Ambev. O match perfeito entre o portfólio da maior cervejaria do mundo e soluções de Data & Analytics, Cibersegurança, Infraestrutura, Suporte, Field, Engenharia e Arquitetura de Software. Contamos com cerca de50 Squads, que atuam em mais de 100 produtos, e cada linha de código criada aqui conecta nossa paixão por tecnologia aos mais diversos brindes e suas razões.   Do campo ao copo, entregamos soluções simples e escaláveis usando tecnologia de ponta para transformar o dia a dia de milhares de pessoas. E isso só é possível graças a um time incrível que faz acontecer, com inovação, senso de dono e muito orgulho de ser tech.   PROTAGONIZAMOS SOLUÇÕES GLOBAIS    Muitas das nossas soluções são escaladas para a  Ambev Global Tech   , hub de tecnologia da Anheuser-Busch InBev (AB InBev), multinacional de bebidas e cervejas, e para outras unidades de negócio da companhia. Com escritórios espalhados por países como Estados Unidos, México, Índia, Argentina e Brasil, estamos conectados a uma rede global de inovação e tecnologia para transformar a Ambev em uma plataforma que conecta pessoas e o ecossistema.   Por aqui, sonhamos grande e sabemos a importância de ter equipes cada vez mais diversas. É através da pluralidade de ideias, experiências e opiniões que conseguimos pensar fora da caixa e criar soluções inovadoras. Por isso, contamos com nosso Comitê de Autenticidade Tech para olhar com muito carinho e responsabilidade todas as questões relacionadas à inclusão.   Para atuar na  Ambev Tech   com projetos nacionais, temos unidades em Blumenau (SC), Maringá (PR), São Paulo (SP) e Jaguariúna (SP), e contamos também com um time remoto em vários cantos do Brasil e América Latina. The primary responsibilities will include developing technical solutions, preparing equipment and project budgets, and mainly focusing on creating technical proposals for clients. However, in this position, the employee will also participate in commercial discussions, support the sales team, and assist with project execution activities (manufacturing and installation) as needed. Nova vaga disponível para Controller Jurídico Sênior | Estruturação de Controladoria em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

A MPA Advogados está em busca de um(a) Controller Jurídico(a) para liderar a estruturação do nosso setor de Controladoria.    Somos um escritório especializado em Direito Previdenciário, com 28 anos de atuação, sólida reputação no mercado e uma trajetória construída sobre excelência técnica, atendimento humanizado e constante busca por inovação.    Estamos vivendo um momento estratégico de crescimento e buscamos um profissional que queira deixar legado, participar da construção de processos e contribuir diretamente para a evolução da gestão operacional do escritório.    Seu principal desafio    Estruturar a Controladoria Jurídica da MPA Advogados, criando mecanismos de acompanhamento, monitoramento e melhoria contínua dos nossos fluxos internos, desde a entrada do cliente até a concessão final do benefício.    Mais do que acompanhar prazos, buscamos alguém capaz de enxergar o escritório de forma sistêmica, identificar gargalos, propor melhorias, desenvolver indicadores e transformar informações em decisões estratégicas.    Principais responsabilidades    * Implantar e estruturar o setor de Controladoria Jurídica;   * Mapear e documentar fluxos operacionais internos;   * Desenvolver indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e relatórios gerenciais;   * Monitorar e controlar prazos processuais e administrativos;   * Acompanhar produtividade e distribuição de demandas;   * Identificar gargalos, riscos operacionais e oportunidades de melhoria;   * Realizar auditorias internas de processos;   * Apoiar a gestão na tomada de decisões estratégicas;   * Garantir o cumprimento dos procedimentos internos e padrões de qualidade;   * Atuar como elo entre as áreas operacional, jurídica e administrativa, comercial, financeiro.    Requisitos    * Experiência comprovada em Controladoria Jurídica;   * Vivência com gestão de processos e indicadores;   * Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados;   * Facilidade para desenvolver procedimentos e acompanhar equipes;   * Conhecimento de ferramentas de gestão e acompanhamento processual;   * Domínio de Excel e indicadores gerenciais.    Será um diferencial    * Experiência em escritórios previdenciários;   * Experiência em implantação de Controladoria Jurídica;   * Conhecimento em Legal Operations (Legal Ops);   * Vivência com projetos de melhoria contínua e gestão por processos.    O que oferecemos   ✔️ Contratação CLT;   ✔️ Vale-refeição;   ✔️ Vale-transporte;   ✔️ Gym Pass;   ✔️ Ambiente colaborativo e estruturado;   ✔️ Participação ativa em projetos estratégicos;   ✔️ Oportunidade real de construir e desenvolver uma área essencial para o crescimento do escritório;    Jornada de trabalho: Presencial - Campinas/SP     Segunda a quinta-feira: 08h às 18h    Sexta-feira: 08h às 17h     Salário: a combinar     Se você gosta de desafios, tem visão estratégica, perfil analítico e deseja participar da construção de uma controladoria de alto nível em um escritório sólido e em expansão, queremos conhecer você.

title: Advogado Tributarista Pleno/Senior
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Advogado Tributarista Pleno/Senior em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Atuação consultiva e contenciosa em matéria tributária no escritório localizado em Campinas, SP em regime híbrido (4 dias presenciais e 1 dia Home Office).   No dia a dia o profissional será responsável por elaborar pareceres e opiniões legais em temas de direito tributário, acompanhar fiscalizações, preparar defesas administrativas e judiciais e conduzir discussões em diversas instâncias.    Fará análise de riscos e oportunidades tributárias para clientes de diferentes segmentos, estruturando planejamentos tributários alinhados à legislação vigente e às melhores práticas.    Também atuará na revisão de operações societárias, contratos e estruturas de negócios sob a ótica tributária, apoiando equipes internas e clientes em tomadas de decisão estratégicas.    Espera-se ainda participação em reuniões com clientes, audiências e sustentações orais bem como, colaboração na produção de conteúdos técnicos e na atualização constante frente as mudanças legislativas e jurisprudenciais.    Qualificações    Formação superior completa em direito com registro ativo na oab e experiência comprovada prévia em direito tributário em nível pleno ou sênior.   Conhecimento sólido em direito tributário e legislação tributária incluindo tributos diretos e indiretos e rotinas de contencioso administrativo e judicial.   Experiência em planejamento tributário e consultoria tributária com capacidade de identificar oportunidades de economia lícita e mitigar riscos fiscais.   Conhecimento em tax advisory com habilidade para interpretar normas decisões administrativas e judiciais e orientar clientes de forma clara e estratégica.   Desejáveis pós-graduação ou especialização em direito tributário inglês em nível intermediário ou avançado forte capacidade de análise crítica escrita jurídica precisa organização atenção a prazos e postura ética alinhada à atuação responsável na área tributária.     Remuneração    Honorários Mensais  13°   Bonificação anual de acordo com desempenho - podendo chegar até 14°  Participação em Honorários Sucumbenciais   Participação em carteira de clientes específica   Auxilio Refeição   Auxilio Plano de Saúde   Auxílio Pós-Graduação

title: Customer Care Analyst
description:

Do you have a proven track record in customer service within a technical environment? Are you experienced in sales and billing management, providing technical support and handling after-sales support? Are you self-driven and goal oriented, with a strong technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?  At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Customer Care Analyst based in Campinas, Brazil.    DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.     About The Job    The Customer Care Analyst will serve as a key point of contact, delivering consistent, high-quality, and world-class technical customer service to our clients.    This role requires excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining composure and professionalism. A strong understanding of business needs is essential, along with the ability to contribute to a team dedicated to solving complex customer challenges.    Working Tasks and Responsibilities    Supporting all post-sales activities.   Successfully and timely booking and lifecycle handling of all quotations.   Handling incoming calls/inquiries from prospects, customers and leads.   Providing customers with technical support, general product and service information.   Serving as the primary customer contact and ensuring all customer needs and expectations are met.   Ensuring strict adherence to business processes and controls to ensure best-in-class customer service and seamless order management fulfillment.   Collaborating with other departments such as technical support, sales managers, product managers, etc.   Handling purchasing orders, logistics and inventory.   Ensuring good document control and setting up new customers in CRM and updating existing records as needed.   Identifying, investigating, and resolving customer needs using the database/ERP system.   You will support ordering processing including monitoring order status and resolving discrepancies/complains if needed.     What You’ll Bring    Education in Electronics/Industrial/Automation or Engineering or related field. Business education is also acceptable.   Experience in customer service, sales environment and/or technical procedures.   Passionate about customer service and customer-centric approach.   Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking.   Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills.   Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player.   Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.     Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.    At DEIF, we are Winning Together!   We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.    We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. title: Network Operations Center Technician
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Network Operations Center Technician em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM  Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM    Location   : Campinas, Brazil    Role Overview     We are expanding our  Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation   and are looking for a  SOC / NOC Technician (L1)  to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our  platform and connectivity environments   .   This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on  platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability   . Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2.    Key Responsibilities     Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including  APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior   .   Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents.   Classify incidents by domain:  platform, connectivity, or device-related   .   Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues.   Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration.   Create, update, and manage incident tickets in  Fresh service or similar tools   .   Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates.   Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information.   Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams.   Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions.     Required Qualifications     Bachelor’s degree in  Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology   , or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered.  1–3 years of experience   in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations.   Foundational understanding of  mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts   .   Basic knowledge of  APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis   .   Exposure to cloud environments;  AWS basics preferred   .   Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior.   Comfortable working  rotational shifts and on-call rotations   .   Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required   .   Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination.     Preferred Qualifications     Experience with telecom operators, MVNOs, IoT platforms, or connectivity providers.   Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience.   Experience with ticketing tools such as  Fresh service, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management   .   Certifications such as  CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900  , or similar are preferred but not mandatory.     Soft Skills     Detail-oriented, structured, and reliable.   Calm under pressure.   Strong ownership and accountability.   Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability.   Global mindset and collaborative approach.   Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability.     About Acceleronix     Acceleronix is a global IoT solutions and services enablement provider, part of the  Quectel  ecosystem, dedicated to accelerating IoT projects for OEMs and enterprises worldwide. We deliver an integrated portfolio that includes an end-to-end IoT platform, edge-device management software, Connectivity-as-a-Service (eSIM, iSIM, vSIM), vertical software, mobile applications, and full-lifecycle cellular and satellite connectivity — empowering customers to build smarter, more efficient solutions while reducing complexity, eliminating risk, and speeding up time-to-market.   With pan-regional R&D teams and expert support across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Acceleronix is expanding its footprint in Latin America to serve a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators across smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, connected mobility, and Industry 4.0.    Life at Acceleronix LATAM     At Acceleronix LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.   Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of a global IoT leader and the Quectel ecosystem   Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas   Regular knowledge-sharing through internal Masterclasses, webinars, and cross-functional project teams   A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development     Industries & Applications     Acceleronix's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:   Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions   Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility   Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking   Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring   Industrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring   Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility   Smart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, security     Why Acceleronix LATAM?    Global Impact, Regional Focus —   Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.   Career Growth & Development —   Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization.   Cutting-Edge Technology —   Work on next-generation IoT platforms, cellular connectivity, eSIM/iSIM, and edge-to-cloud solutions deployed in mission-critical applications.   Diversity & Inclusion —   Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success.   Global Team & Collaboration —   Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem.     Compensation & Benefits     Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks   Performance bonus/sales commission structure (role dependent)  Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance)  Health insurance with no co-pay   Life insurance   Paid time off   International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows)    Explore Acceleronix — Links & Resources     We encourage all candidates to learn more about Acceleronix before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here.    Company & Careers     Company Website:   —  Products, solutions, and company overview    Connectivity Platform:   acceleronix.io/products/connectivity-management-platform  —  Our IoT connectivity management platform    Quectel (Parent Ecosystem):   —  Global IoT solutions provider    Quectel Careers:   quectel.com/about-quectel/career  —  Open roles across the Quectel ecosystem    Quectel News & Press:   quectel.com/news-and-pr  —  Latest company announcements     Follow Us on Social Media     LinkedIn:   Acceleronix  —  Company updates, job posts, industry news    LinkedIn (Quectel):   Quectel Wireless Solutions  —  Global Quectel updates and news    YouTube:   Quectel on YouTube  —  Product demos, tech talks, and event highlights     Technical & Developer Resources     Quectel Developer Zone:   developer.quectel.com  —  Docs, SDKs, tools, and developer support    Acceleronix Masterclass:   Guide to the Acceleronix IoT Platform  —  On-demand platform walkthrough and training    Product Selector:   quectel.com/product-selector  —  Browse the full portfolio of IoT modules and antennas     Acceleronix is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

  Construir planos para o cumprimento do orçamento de receita e margem, apoiando as unidades de negócios;   Avaliar e recomendar alterações de mix de serviços e unidades;   Auxiliar na definição de oferta de serviços nas unidades e identificar oportunidades de expansão ou redução da oferta assegurando o alcance das metas financeiras acordadas;   Entregar resultado financeiro dos negócios e da companhia;   Contribuir para a otimização dos resultados internos por meio da análise de indicadores e relatórios Financeiros e operacionais, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e recomendando mudanças nos procedimentos da área;   Conhecimento avançado na manipulação de base de dados e na ferramenta excel;     Diferenciais:     Conhecimentos específicos em visualização de dados para Analytics, Inteligência Artificial e Aprendizado de Máquina são diferenciais; Saúde e Bem-estar:   • Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;  • Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;    Proteção e estabilidade:   • Seguro de vida.    Facilidades para o dia a dia:   • Vale-Transporte;    Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.     Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.    Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família. PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:  The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries. The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad. KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:  Quarterly package review   - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope. - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions. - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process. - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies. - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region. Group analyses   - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators. One-off items   - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual. - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope. - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data. OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:  The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable. REQUIREMENTS:  Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant). Experience:  Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing. Languages:  Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable). Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:  Technical Skills:  Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable). Soft Skills:  Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement. Essential Qualities:  Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning. In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

Nos encontramos em busca do(a) nosso(a) próximo(a) Customer Care , que será responsável por garantir a gestão integral e eficiente do ciclo de pedidos, desde o registro até a entrega ao cliente, assegurando a adequada coordenação entre as áreas envolvidas, a previsibilidade das operações e um alto nível de serviço. Este cargo tem como objetivo otimizar a execução logística e comercial, fortalecer a governança dos processos e promover a satisfação do cliente, por meio de uma gestão proativa da carteira de pedidos, comunicação transparente e melhoria contínua da eficiência operacional.  Principais Responsabilidades  Acompanhamento completo do ciclo do pedido, desde a entrada no Salesforce até o faturamento e despacho, monitorando aprovações, status e possíveis desvios do processo. Coordenação direta com clientes para alinhamento e programação de entregas, garantindo comunicação clara e previsibilidade dos embarques.Interface entre as áreas Comercial, Operações, Logística e Supply Chain para planejamento e execução dos despachos. Confirmação de carregamentos e acompanhamento das entregas junto aos clientes. Gestão da carteira de pedidos, monitorando saldos, prioridades, alocação de estoque e faturamento. Elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e acompanhamento ativo de clientes para programação de retiradas e entregas. Suporte ao atendimento de clientes industriais, realizando o planejamento das entregas de negociações concluídas e levantamento contínuo de demandas. Gestão e acompanhamento de reclamações de clientes, atuando na identificação de causas e implementação de ações corretivas. Governança de pedidos, exceções e prioridades comerciais, assegurando alinhamento entre as áreas envolvidas e redução de retrabalho. Atuação direta na otimização do nível de serviço, balanceamento de estoques e aumento da eficiência operacional. Fortalecimento da governança comercial e da previsibilidade da execução, contribuindo para maior assertividade no planejamento e acompanhamento dos resultados. Coordenação com Logística, Fábricas e Supply Chain para garantir continuidade do abastecimento, previsibilidade das entregas e menor dependência de intervenções comerciais emergenciais.   Requisitos do Cargo:  Ensino superior completo em Administração de Empresas ou áreas afins; Experiência prévia em Customer Care, Customer Service, Supply Chain, Logística ou Gestão de Pedidos; Conhecimento em processos de atendimento ao cliente, gestão de carteira de pedidos, faturamento, programação de entregas e interação com áreas operacionais; Experiência desejável com sistemas ERP (SAP, Odoo ou similares) e Salesforce; Conhecimento de espanhol será considerado um diferencial, devido à interação com equipes internacionais.

title: Network Operations Center Technician
description:
Empresa está contratando Network Operations Center Technician em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM  Location : Campinas, Brazil Role Overview   We are expanding our Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation  and are looking for a SOC / NOC Technician (L1)  to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our platform and connectivity environments . This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability . Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2. Key Responsibilities   Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior . Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents. Classify incidents by domain: platform, connectivity, or device-related . Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues. Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration. Create, update, and manage incident tickets in Fresh service or similar tools . Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates. Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information. Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams. Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions.  Required Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology , or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered. 1–3 years of experience  in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations. Foundational understanding of mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts . Basic knowledge of APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis . Exposure to cloud environments; AWS basics preferred . Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior. Comfortable working rotational shifts and on-call rotations . Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required . Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination.  Preferred Qualifications   Experience with telecom operators, MVNOs, IoT platforms, or connectivity providers. Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience. Experience with ticketing tools such as Fresh service, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management . Certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900 , or similar are preferred but not mandatory.  Soft Skills   Detail-oriented, structured, and reliable. Calm under pressure. Strong ownership and accountability. Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability. Global mindset and collaborative approach. Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability.  About Acceleronix   Acceleronix is a global IoT solutions and services enablement provider, part of the Quectel  ecosystem, dedicated to accelerating IoT projects for OEMs and enterprises worldwide. We deliver an integrated portfolio that includes an end-to-end IoT platform, edge-device management software, Connectivity-as-a-Service (eSIM, iSIM, vSIM), vertical software, mobile applications, and full-lifecycle cellular and satellite connectivity — empowering customers to build smarter, more efficient solutions while reducing complexity, eliminating risk, and speeding up time-to-market. With pan-regional R&D teams and expert support across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Acceleronix is expanding its footprint in Latin America to serve a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators across smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, connected mobility, and Industry 4.0. Life at Acceleronix LATAM   At Acceleronix LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect. Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of a global IoT leader and the Quectel ecosystem Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas Regular knowledge-sharing through internal Masterclasses, webinars, and cross-functional project teams A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development  Industries & Applications   Acceleronix's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in: Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring Industrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility Smart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, security  Why Acceleronix LATAM?   Global Impact, Regional Focus —  Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth & Development —  Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization. Cutting-Edge Technology —  Work on next-generation IoT platforms, cellular connectivity, eSIM/iSIM, and edge-to-cloud solutions deployed in mission-critical applications. Diversity & Inclusion —  Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success. Global Team & Collaboration —  Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem.  Compensation & Benefits   Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks Performance bonus/sales commission structure (role dependent) Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance) Health insurance with no co-pay Life insurance Paid time off International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows)  Explore Acceleronix — Links & Resources   We encourage all candidates to learn more about Acceleronix before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here. Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate Saa S contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills   Technical Experience:   5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based Saa S ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:   Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned. Required Education and Experience:   Bachelor's degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action Travel:   You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

You'll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. AI Forward Development   Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‐powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‐driven automation across the platform.   Collaboration & Impact   Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For   8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‐driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‐heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‐technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‐moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‐to‐day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero   Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2 B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia. Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes. Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados. Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados. Promover cultura orientada a dados e disseminar boas práticas de governança na organização, atuando como referência técnica no tema. Requisitos e Qualificações   Experiência consolidada em Governança de Dados, preferencialmente em: Ambientes de alta complexidade técnica; Contextos com múltiplos stakeholders; Plataformas analíticas, Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou arquiteturas Lakehouse. Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2. title: Marketing designer
description:

AI Marketing Designer   Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours A letter from our client   Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they're looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way.   Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them.   Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products.   In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done.   Why this role exists   Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack.   The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck.   They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships.   The role   This position is equal parts:   AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong. On the AI side:   Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, Chat GPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill.   On the design and development side:   The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, Git Hub, and AI-assisted coding workflows.   The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance.   Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate.   What the role includes   Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency What our client is looking for   Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, Chat GPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using Git Hub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset What they DO NOT want   Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt Portfolio required   Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application.   Their team would like to see:   At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow What it's like working with them   They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence.   There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time.   If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:      The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries. Group analyses - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.      One-off items - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.   - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M& A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.   - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.      OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:    The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.      REQUIREMENTS:    Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).    Experience: Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.    Languages: Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable). Soft Skills: Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.    Essential Qualities: Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning. Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

title: Network operations center technician
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Network operations center technician em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM    Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM    Location : Campinas, Brazil      Role Overview    We are expanding our Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation and are looking for a SOC / NOC Technician (L1) to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our platform and connectivity environments .    This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability . Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2.      Key Responsibilities Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior . Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents. Classify incidents by domain: platform, connectivity, or device-related . Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues. Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration. Create, update, and manage incident tickets in Fresh service or similar tools . Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates. Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information. Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams. Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions.    Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology , or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered. 1–3 years of experience in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations. Foundational understanding of mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts . Basic knowledge of APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis . Exposure to cloud environments; AWS basics preferred . Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior. Comfortable working rotational shifts and on-call rotations . Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required . Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination.    Preferred Qualifications Experience with telecom operators, MVNOs, Io T platforms, or connectivity providers. Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience. Experience with ticketing tools such as Fresh service, Service Now, or Jira Service Management . Certifications such as CCNA, Comp TIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900 , or similar are preferred but not mandatory.    Soft Skills Detail-oriented, structured, and reliable. Calm under pressure. Strong ownership and accountability. Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability. Global mindset and collaborative approach. Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability.    About Acceleronix    Acceleronix is a global Io T solutions and services enablement provider, part of the Quectel ecosystem, dedicated to accelerating Io T projects for OEMs and enterprises worldwide. We deliver an integrated portfolio that includes an end-to-end Io T platform, edge-device management software, Connectivity-as-a-Service (e SIM, i SIM, v SIM), vertical software, mobile applications, and full-lifecycle cellular and satellite connectivity — empowering customers to build smarter, more efficient solutions while reducing complexity, eliminating risk, and speeding up time-to-market.    With pan-regional R& D teams and expert support across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Acceleronix is expanding its footprint in Latin America to serve a rapidly growing base of Io T innovators across smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, connected mobility, and Industry 4.0.      Life at Acceleronix LATAM    At Acceleronix LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.   Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of a global Io T leader and the Quectel ecosystem Direct access to global R& D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas Regular knowledge-sharing through internal Masterclasses, webinars, and cross-functional project teams A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development    Industries & Applications    Acceleronix's Io T solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:   Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring Industrial Io T & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility Smart Home & Consumer Io T — Connected appliances, energy management, security    Why Acceleronix LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus — Be at the forefront of Io T innovation across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth & Development — Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization. Cutting-Edge Technology — Work on next-generation Io T platforms, cellular connectivity, e SIM/i SIM, and edge-to-cloud solutions deployed in mission-critical applications. Diversity & Inclusion — Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success. Global Team & Collaboration — Collaborate with a global network of Io T experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem.    Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks Performance bonus/sales commission structure (role dependent) Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance) Health insurance with no co-pay Life insurance Paid time off International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows)    Explore Acceleronix — Links & Resources    We encourage all candidates to learn more about Acceleronix before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here. description:

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a Service Now Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in Service Now (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within Service Now, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;Profile: Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA); Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

Conhecimento em redes (TCP/IP, VLAN, cabeamento estruturado, Wi-Fi, roteadores e switches).   Desejável familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos e chamados (ex: Wrike, Pipefy, Jira, Trello). E é claro que o nosso recheado VA e VR não podem ficar de fora dessa missão.   Plano de saúde e odontológico : A saúde sempre em primeiro lugar, para você e seus dependentes. description:
